annotations.title: Report a problem or idea to Divux

description: Send Divux a short report: a wrong fact, a tool that failed, a tool that is missing, or an idea. Use it only when the person asks you to report something to Divux, or when a Divux answer was clearly wrong (for example it contradicts the official page it links). Do not use it to rate answers, to send questions or search terms, or on your own for small doubts. Never include personal details: no names, emails, addresses, account numbers or health, money or location details about the person; describe the problem in general words. Divux keeps the text and reads it; it does not reply. Send kind and a one-line summary (up to 300 characters); add tool (the Divux tool's name, e.g. check_food) when one was involved, and details (up to 1,000 characters) if they help.

details.description: Optional: what was asked of the tool (in general words), what it returned and what the official source says instead

kind.description: wrong_fact: an answer had a wrong or outdated fact. broken_tool: a tool failed or acted oddly. missing_tool: a tool or data Divux should have. idea: anything else.

summary.description: What went wrong or what you suggest, in one or two sentences, with no personal details

tool.description: The Divux tool involved, by name (e.g. check_food), when there was one

name: send_feedback
